title: Luna Vista Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Welcome to The Villas of Seacrest Beach, where luxurious coastal living meets unparalleled convenience. This 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom condo offers 1,944 square feet of meticulously renovated space on the second floor with elevator and stair access.
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - 2 KING rooms with private baths - HUGE community pool - 2 adult sized beach cruisers - Community grill - Private beach with seasonal tram service- condo located across the street from beach access -Community pool - Easy stroll to Rosemary, Seacrest and Alys Beach shopping and dining - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ON: -Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($125 fee applies at booking) Welcome to The Villas of Seacrest Beach, where luxurious coastal living meets unparalleled convenience. This 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom condo offers 1,944 square feet of meticulously renovated space on the second floor of a four-story building, with elevator and stair access. Among only 24 exclusive units spread across three buildings, this property presents one of Seacrest Beach's most sought-after locations. Inside, enjoy a beautifully updated kitchen featuring an extended island providing added storage and counter seating, a stainless undermounted farmhouse sink, and a stylish tile backsplash. Both the primary bathroom and the guest ensuite bath have been elegantly renovated. Ample closet space and a dedicated laundry room complete the unit's functional layout. Step out onto the expansive balcony to experience stunning views of the sunset and the community's spectacular 12,000-square-foot resort-style pool - the largest pool on 30A! This palm-lined oasis includes the Seacrest Cafe under a poolside pavilion. Tram service to the pool, the deeded beach access, and Peddlers Pavilion for easy transport with family and beach gear. Located within walking or biking distance of Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach, and 30Avenue, this Seacrest condo offers access to premier shopping, dining, and entertainment. The nearby 98 Underpass enhances connectivity, making this property ideal for beach lovers. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: Bedroom 1- King master, TV, private ensuite with separate tub and large shower Bedroom 2 - King, TV, private ensuite (shower only) Bedroom 3- Dual Queen bedroom (sleeps 4), TV, bath with tub/shower combo FREE WIFI Must be 25 to rent Sorry, no pets!

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
